book.name: Matyu
book.title: WAI PII EPE MATYUAME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Akali Papa Tambutae Mende Tolasiamo Doko
Jisasa sipi dokonya pyakalyetala, endaki pete omotena, baanya siti dokonya pea.
Pateamopa, akali mendapuame akali papa tambutae mende lapa toko dokonya soo baa katea dokonya epeami. Dokopa akali dokaitame tungi piamino doko Jisasame kandatala, papa tambutae doko lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambanya ikiningi, embanya koo dupa kunao nepatae kalyenona, emba mona kenda nakaeyape”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa, Mosesanya loo mana nyepae mendapuame nyakama-lapo lao pituu, “Akali dakeme Gote anda-anda semaiya naeyao lelyamona” leami.
Dopa lao masoo leamino dupa Jisasame kandatala dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Aipuma nyakamanya moname koo dopale dupa masilyami?
Pii dalaponya anduku mee petala lapenge? ‘Embanya koo dupa kunao nepatae kalyenona’ lapenge dokope, pande, ‘Emba sakatatala kaita pae’ lapenge doko?
Akalinya Ikiningi dokome isa yuu dakenya katao, endakalinya koo dupa kunao nepenge kyeto doko baa-kisa singi-lamo lao kanjepalena”

content: lea. Dopa latala baame akali papa tambutae doko lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Emba sakatatala, embanya lapa toko doko nyoo soo andaka puu”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa akali doko sakatatala andaka pea.
Dopa piamo doko endakali kambu piami dupame kandatala, kyeto dopale dupa Goteme endakali dupa maiya-lamo lao walu lao paka kaeyapala, Gote mambo piami.
Matyu Wii Lao Nyiamo Doko
Jisasa baa yuu doko yakinatala pao pituu, akali Matyu lenge mende, takisa nyingi anda dokonya peteamo kandatala baa lamaiyoo,
lea. Dokopa baa sakatatala Jisasa watao pea.
Maitakao Jisasa baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa Matyuanya andaka nee nao peteaminopa, dokonya takisa nyingipi, koo pingipi longo mendapu ipupala, apata nee nao peteami.
Peteaminopa Parasi dupame kandatala, Jisasanya disaipolo dupa lamaiyoo, “Nyakamanya mana lenge doko aipuma takisa nyingipi, koo pingipi dupa-pipa nee nao pilyape?” leami.
Pii leamino doko sepala Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Endakali yaina napingi dupa dokosa yangyala naenge. Endakali yaina pyapae dupa dokosa yangingi.

‘Endakali dupame kundi iki dimi laka lao masala naelyo. Endakali dupa kondo kaeyami laka lao masilyona’ lapae singi dokonya tenge doko nyakamame pupala mana nyalapape. Nambame endakali tolatae dupa wii lao nyalanya naepeo. Endakali koo pingi dupa mona kapilyina lao, wii lao nyalanya epeona”

content: lea.
Loma Soo Nee Nanao Katenge Dokonya Tipa Piamino Doko

Gii dokopa Jonenya disaipolo dupa Jisasa katea dokonya ipupala baa lamaiyoo, “Naimapi, Parasipi dupame paa longosa loma soo nee nanao katengena, embanya disaipolo dupame aipuma dopa napingimape?” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Akali mende enda kelyapala watapae pyao, baanya tata dupa-pipa kalyamo gii dokopa, baanya tata dupame ee lao katengemape? Gii doko palitamopa, akali enda kelyenge doko nyoo patataminopa, baanya tata dupame loma soo nee nanao katatami.
Yonge pee atingi mende tii telyamopa, lapalapa kangupae enenge mendeme kii pimbala naenge. Kii pimbatamino doko, enenge doko inungunyeta dokome, atingi doko etete kanguu koeyaseta.

Endakali dupame waene enenge kamuu penge meme yanungimi wasepae atingi mendenya pyandala naengema. Kamuu pyandatamino doko, penge doko kanguu koeyasetamopa, waene dupa kai lao pata. Waene enenge doko penge enengenyaka kamuu pisilyaminopa, waenepa, pengepa dolapo lapota koeyala naengena”

content: lea.
Isingi Akali Mendenya Wanenge Sakatasiamo Doko

Jisasame pii dutupa lamaiyoo kateamopa, isingi akali mende Jisasa katea dokonya ipao luma lakapala, baa lamaiyoo, “Nambanya wanenge doko epapu kumatelyamona, embame baa-kisa kingi setateno doko, baa lenge talapomona, kingi setala ipupoko” lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasa sakatatala, baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa akali doko watao peami.

Dokopa enda mende yuu gii dii lao andaka nao paliu, ee kana 12 pitaka petenge dokome, Jisasanya yonge peenya iki watandatopa, baanya yaina doko etalapomona lao masia. Dopa lao masetala, Jisasanya maita-kaita ipupala, Jisasanya yonge pee punanya kingimi watandea.
Dokopa Jisasa kapilyetala, enda doko kandatala baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Wanenge, embame namba tungi pyapi dokome, embanya yaina doko etelyamona, emba mona kenda nakaeyape”

content: lea. Dopa lea gii dokopaka, enda dokonya yaina doko etea.
Dokopa isingi akali dokonya andaka Jisasa pao kolandatala kandeamopa, endakali mendapu kumanda pituu pulupapu pyao ee wee leaminopa, endakali kambu pyao peteami dupa yamataka lao ee leami.
Ee leaminopa baame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Wanaku doko kumala naeyalamo. Baa luu palelyamona, nyakama pupa”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa, endakali dupame baa lamba lao gii kaeyami.
Dokopa Jisasame endakali kambu doko kamaka watao pyalyetala, baa wanaku kumapae doko sia dokonya pea. Pupala wanaku doko kinginya minao sakatasiamopa, baa sakatea.
Dopa pia dokonya atome doko yuu makisa singi dupa pitakanya lao taeyami.
Lenge Monda Mendalaponya Lenge Auu Pisakamaiyamo Doko
Jisasa yuu doko yakinatala peamopa, akali lenge monda mendalapome wii lao, “Dapita Ikiningi, embame nalimba kondo kaeyapoko!” lao baa watao peambi.
Jisasa andaka kolandatala peteamopa, lenge monda dolapo baa petea dokonya epeambi. Epeambinopa Jisasame dolapo lamaiyoo,
lea. Dopa leamopa dolapome baa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, embame kiningi nalimba nisalapenona” leambi.
Dokopa Jisasame akali dolaponya lengenya watandatala lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakambame namba tungi pilyambino dokonya, nyakambanya masilyambinoli pilyamona”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa akali dolaponya lenge dolapo auu pyoo teambi. Dokopa Jisasame akali dolapo kyeto joo lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakamba-kisa pilyamo dake endakali waka mendeme setana, lamaiya naeyalapape”

content: lea.
Dopaka doko, Jisasame pia dupa pitaka akali dolapome yuu makisa singi dupa pitakanya lao taeyambi.
Muumaa Mende Nisiamo Doko
Akali dolapo peambinopa, endakali mendapuame imambu koo paleta, akali muumaa mende laminao Jisasa katea dokonya epeami.

Ipateaminopa, akali doko-kisa imambu koo palea doko Jisasame watao pyateamopa, muumaa doko pii lea. Pii leamopa, endakali kambu piami dupa walu latala lao pituu, “Israele yuu dakenya yuu mendaipi mende kalai dapale mende nakandeamana” leami.
Dopaka doko, Parasi dupame lao pituu, “Imambu koo dupanya isingi dokonya pupu lapae dokome imambu koo dupa baame watao pilyamona” leami.
Endakali Dupa Kondo Kaeyamo Doko

Jisasame sitipi, yuu yakanepi dupa pitakanya paeyao, dokaitanya lotuu anda dupanya mana lamaita, kingdom kaiti-kisa singi dokonya lao wai pii epe doko lamaita pia. Dokopa endakali yaina tata waka-waka dupame pyapae dupa pitaka baame mee jeta pyakamaiya.
Sipisipi setao katenge mende daa jilyamopa, sipisipi dupa nisepae nanyepala kenda soo katengemali pyoo, endakali kambu dupa kenda soo kateamino kandatala, Jisasame dokaita kondo kaeya.
Kondo kaeyapala baanya disaipolo dupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nee longo wambu petamupa, kalai akali kuki kalyamino.
Dopana, nee mandyoo mau pyapenge kalai akali mendapu peena lao, ee tange Kamongo doko kyeto joo loma salapape”

content: lea.
